bio: Non-profit nursing home in Lincoln with 23 certified beds. Provides 24-hour skilled nursing care, long-term care, and short-term rehab. Part of a continuing care retirement community, so residents can move between levels of care on one campus. Certified for Medicare only, so it does not take Medicaid.
